description: Aquitaine : Schéma Régional Eolien - Zones de contraintes absolues is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by donnees.aquitaine.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Localisation of absolute constraints not allowing the development of wind energy, as defined in the “Regional Wind Scheme” approved on 6 July 2012 and annexed to the regional climate, air and energy scheme (SRCAE). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Aquitaine: Eolien Regional Schema — Absolute Constraint Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
